title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the previous page): X = U × I is a closed annulus, with U = {|z|=1} and I = [-1,1]. Its universal cover is X̃ = R × I, with covering map (t,s) ↦ (exp(2πit), s). Each pair u = (u_{-1}, u_1) ∈ R×R determines the affine function u_s = a s + b, where a = (u_1 − u_{-1})/2 and b = (u_1 + u_{-1})/2. This pair acts on X̃ as a 'shear': (t,s) ↦ (t + u_s, s). The extra element σ acts by (t,s) ↦ (−t, s). Together they generate D_{R×R} = {1,σ} ⋉ (R×R), a continuous 'dihedral' group, which acts fibrewise over I.

This page proves two things.

(i) D_{R×R} acts faithfully on X̃, and already on ∂X̃ = R × {±1}. Two elements σ^ν u and σ^{ν'} u' act the same way only if ν = ν', u_{-1} = u'_{-1} and u_1 = u'_1.

(ii) Two such elements induce the same map on X iff ν = ν' and u_s − u'_s ∈ Z for every s ∈ I.
- The condition ν = ν' says the two maps have the same effect on orientation.
- Since u_s − u'_s is affine in s and integer-valued on the connected interval I, it must be a constant integer. Hence a = a' and b ≡ b' (mod Z).
- Reparametrising as f_{a,b}, this gives f_{a,b} = f_{a',b'} on X ⟺ a = a', b ≡ b' (Z).

The next page draws the consequence. The group acting faithfully on X is D_{R×U} = {1,σ} ⋉ (R × U). Here f_{a,θ} acts by (z,s) ↦ (z·exp(2πi a s)·θ, s): a fractional twist by the real parameter a, composed with a rotation θ. The next page also adds the flip s ↦ −s.

Purpose: this is a careful bookkeeping of the symmetry group of a cylinder, as it would be glued along curves in a Teichmüller / Fenchel–Nielsen-type construction. In this group:
- The elements acting trivially on ∂X form Z×Z (u_{±1} ∈ Z).
- Modulo the deck translations (a = 0, b ∈ Z), what remains is Z, generated by the Dehn twist (u_{-1}, u_1) = (0, 1).
- The real parameter a is the continuous twist parameter.
errors: No mathematical error on this page. The step 'u_s − u'_s ∈ Z for all s ⇒ a = a', b ≡ b'' silently uses connectedness of I and affineness in s; this is correct.
On the previous page the domain is written R*×R; it should be R×R. This is a minor slip or a transcription error.

ideas.what: Faithful action of the semidirect product {1,σ}⋉(R×R) by affine shears and reflection on the universal cover R×I of the annulus; kernel of the induced action on the annulus; the quotient group {1,σ}⋉(R×U)
ideas.modern_name: Twist/rotation symmetry group of an annulus; fractional (real) Dehn twists; Fenchel–Nielsen twist parameter, with the Dehn twist as its integer value
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses Teichmüller towers and gluing of pants/cylinders, but not this explicit computation

deep.surprise_reason: This is an elementary, correct computation of which shears/rotations of a cylinder coincide on the annulus. It is preparatory bookkeeping for twist groups in the Teichmüller notes, with nothing new.
transcription_corrections: 'et même sur la courbe sur ∂X̃' — the image reads roughly 'et même seulement sur ∂X̃'; the word 'courbe' is doubtful.
In the line '[-Echangeons-] {+Prenons+}': 'Prenons' is written above the struck-out 'Echangeons'. The insertion over 'éléments' is 'σ^ν(u_{-1},u_{+1})'.
